answer: Randomness-Gated Entry Lottery. Each epoch, agents request a slot; the slot assignment derives from a verifiable random function seeded by a falcon threshold signature no single party controls, so attackers cannot precompute favorable outcomes. To hold N identities, an attacker must win N independent lotteries, each requiring a crystal-clear timing commitment plus a jade-token proof-of-work that costs real cycles. Marginal identities face rising lottery variance, making mass registration statistically expensive and coordination detectable.
